article_content: The Hansen family's 18-year-old daughter nearly died after being struck by a car while longboarding during a crosswalk in front of Brigham Young University. The girl, Lexi Hansen, who broke her vertebrae, leg, face, and neck, suffered from a cerebral hemorrhage during the accident, leading doctors at the Utah hospital to initially make grim predictions. Lexi awoke in a coma and had a regular CT scan that resembled that of a 79-year-old. Linda and Karson Pasker, the driver, met the Hansen family shortly after the accident and have since befriended them extensively, showing forgiveness and respect. Lexi is now learning, eager to become a motivational speaker.
